contracts.action: Moves `notifyOverridesChanged()` from the end of `persistActive` (before the gate commits) into `afterCommit`, so the effective-settings recompute, listener wake-up and broadcast happen only after the switch is certain.
contracts.equivalent_path: Other callers of `notifyOverridesChanged`: `WorkspaceSettings`' `changed` callback at index.ts:130 (override writes, answers, capture-start refresh), and the settings-store tests (settings-store.test.ts:276-338). They call it after the cache or active id has already changed, as the new site does.
contracts.before_after: Before: `persistActive` ran `reg.setActive`, `workspaceSettings.refresh(target)`, then notified, all while the gate was closed and before `dropPendingCaptures` and `gate.commit` (switch-transaction.ts:70-80). If anything after the notify threw, windows would already have the new workspace's settings. After: `persistActive` only persists and prepares (index.ts:423-428). `switchWorkspace` then runs `dropPendingCaptures`, `gate.commit`, and `afterCommit`, which notifies first and then refreshes titles, broadcasts state and the library (switch-transaction.ts:79-80, index.ts:404-410). `activeOverrides` reads `reg.active().id`, which `setActive` has already switched, so the recompute sees the target workspace.
contracts.visible_effect: After a switch, every window gets the new workspace's effective settings in the same commit step as the state and library broadcast. `notifyOverridesChanged` skips the broadcast when the JSON is unchanged (settings-store.ts:232-238), so a switch between workspaces with equal settings sends nothing extra.
contracts.failure_mode: A failed `persistActive` (switch-transaction.ts:73-77) now never notifies, so the old workspace's settings stay in effect, which is what the transaction intends. `relocateActive` also calls `afterCommit` (switch-transaction.ts:136), so a folder relocation now triggers a recompute. That is a no-op when nothing changed. `afterCommit` is synchronous, and a throw in the notify would skip `refreshTitles` and the broadcasts. This was not read as a realistic risk, since `recomputeEffective` is pure and the listeners are in-process.
